{{Quote|O-Vieve had a vision of the Jedi. She claims that an evil force will engulf those who are close to the Jedi&hellip; that darkness surrounds the Jedi&hellip; ''[that it]'' comes from within them and then spreads to engulf them&hellip; ''[She sees]'' flashes of a future destructive event&hellip; destruction&hellip; from an explosive device sent to destroy an entire planet without a shiver&hellip; an invasion of evil&hellip; evil cloaking our planet like a black cloud&hellip; masked soldiers&hellip; They will bring fear and suffering.''"<br />"''There is no explosive device powerful enough to destroy a whole planet.''"<br />"''Not yet, perhaps.|[[V-Nen]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], and [[O-Melie]]|<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />}}
'''O-Vieve''', also known as '''Vieve''',<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was one of the [[Benevolent Guide]]s during [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan's]] isolationist period.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" /> She often had visions of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] invasion of Kegan,<ref name="CSWE" /> which led her to [[V-Tan]], who had dreams about future events. When they met each other they realized that their visions and dreams matched. Their visions and dreams involved [[Masked Soldiers]] invading the planet.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" /> They also had dreams and visions of their destruction through an explosive device that could wipe out a planet. Together, the two developed a system of isolationism in an attempt to thwart the invasion, but the [[Keganite]]s eventually rejected their leaders upon learning of the brainwashing children underwent at the [[Re-Learning Circle]].<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />

==History==
V-Tan and O-Vieve set up an isolationist government that controlled the people rigorously. They were more-or-less dictators on an officially-democratic planet [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]], allowing votes but controlling the subject of the vote. Furthermore, [[autohopper]]s, automatically controlled [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhoppers]], were used to monitor the people, their movements, and their conversations. To encourage the isolated behavior, the pair developed a curriculum known as [[The Learning]] around [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]]. This school of thought emphasized sacrificing one's own desires in favor of contributing to the [[General Good]]. A school known as the [[Learning Circle]] was set up outside the city to teach kids from the ages of four to sixteen. Furthermore, a secret [[Re-Learning Circle]] was created within the [[Learning Circle]] to brainwash people to believe as V-Tan and O-Vieve did if they became undisciplined or were considered too physically ill to contribute to society. While Keganites under O-Vieve's rule enjoyed a mostly peaceful society where all of their basic needs were met, the isolationist policy restricted the people from benefiting from advances throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in medicine, technology, and other fields.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />

The two guides lived in the [[Central Dwelling]], part of the [[Gathering Circle]] at the center of the city of Kegan.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />

==Downfall==
{{Quote|I still don't understand how an entire planet could place its trust so blindly in visions and dreams.''"<br />"''We do not know if O-Vieve's visions were wrong, Padawan. O-Vieve's vision of the future was clouded, but that doesn't make it invalid.''"<br />"''That I don't believe. I can't imagine one central evil controlling the whole galaxy. That would be impossible.''"<br />"''I hope we do not see it, Obi-Wan. But we cannot say it is impossible. Haven't you experienced enough of chance and evil in the galaxy to realize that?''"<br />"''She saw darkness coming from the Jedi itself. That could never happen.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />}}
After [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] came to the planet to assess if a [[Olana Chion/Legends|baby]] born on the planet was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], V-Tan and O-Vieve had the child kidnapped and sent to the Re-Learning Circle. The [[Master]]s, while searching for Force-sensitive [[Olana Chion/Legends|O-Lana]] and their Padawans, who had also been captured by a [[Truant Guide]], disrupted the system of skyhoppers that closely monitored the populace and helped rescue their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] from the secure school. After they escaped, they exposed V-Tan and O-Vieve for their totalitarian ways, and the two rulers (viewed by the populace as overprotective, at best; tyrannical, at worst) were voted down from their posts as the "Benevolent Guides" of Kegan. The Force-sensitive child, the only daughter of V-Nen and O-Melie, was removed by the Jedi team to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />
